questions.question: Elkanah had two wives named Hannah and Peninnah. Which one of them had children?
When Hannah prayed for a son at Shiloh, what did she vow to do if the LORD gave her one?

answers.text: Dedicate him to the LORD for life
Name him after his father Elkanah
Throw a feast for all of Shiloh

answers.text: She had asked the LORD for him
Eli the priest picked it out
